Baird cuts target for JBT Marel stock to USD 171.00
Barclays sets USD 150.00 target for JBT Marel stock

summary: Marel is company from Iceland, founded in 1983. Type: listed company. About 3,749 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about acquisitions; 1 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: Food-processing machinery maker, now part of US-owned JBT Marel; Dutch sites in Boxmeer and Eindhoven hire in finance, operations and sales.

culture.text: Builds equipment and software for poultry, meat and fish processing, with automation replacing labour-intensive tasks.
Staff are mostly mechanical, electrical and mechatronics engineers or business graduates; HAN University of Applied Sciences is among top schools.
Describes an inclusive team culture with collaboration across global teams.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (Marel Customer Center, Marel Holding and Marel Further Processing B.V.).
All 3 current jobs here, in Eindhoven and Boxmeer, don't require Dutch.

growth.text: About 3,749 people on LinkedIn; the group reported record orders in a messy quarter, per the headline.

worth_knowing.text: Now owned by US-based JBT Marel Corporation after a merger.
A law firm invited investors to join a fraud investigation into JBT Marel Corporation.
